select bq.sys_id, bq.qna_title, bq.qna_description, bq.start_date, bq.file_ulid, bq.answer_yn, bq.answer_datetime, bq.answer_description from brd_qna bq where 1=1
and (bq.qna_title like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') or bq.qna_description like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
and bq.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and bq.delete_yn = 'N'
